android.desc:
The FUNetix 12 Hour Reading App is a patented, 40 module, 2,000 screens, fully narrated, tastefully animated, simulated one-on-one tutoring experience, that will teach your child how to read with minimal adult help required.  

Based on 17 years of field testing and clinical research, FUNetix teaches all of the 44 sounds of English first (phonemic awareness), and then uses a patented pronunciation guide to “show” children the sounds in every word, and the “sound pieces” and spelling patterns unique to the English language (phonics).

Presented by the American  Youth Literacy Foundation 501 (c) (3), a nationwide, charitable non-profit, dedicated to teaching EVERY child in America how to read by the end of 3rd grade, the app is absolutely FREE!
